about: v2 sync-vs-async plan. Pilot (phase 0) fixes cap (6144 vs 8192), learner flags and the prompt filter; the tiers reuse these args. {cap}, {model_len}, {schedule}, {learner_flags} are filled from pilot/decision.json.

pilot.chips_0_2: qrl.profile_prompts: 919 train prompts x 8 samples, cap 8192, T=1.0 (3 shards) -> profile.json
chip_3: tpu/bench_learner.py sweep: gdn-chunk 64/256 x mb-tokens 0/16384/32768, then compile + contig-grad
pilot.then_all_chips: base-model eval v2, 32 samples, cap 8192 (step-0 reference for every run)

decision_rules.cap: 8192 if survival(8192) <= 0.45 or truncated_loop_frac < 0.5; else 6144 (more length cannot fix loops)
decision_rules.learner_flags: fastest bench config whose fwd+bwd completes; default --gdn-chunk 256 --mb-tokens 16384
decision_rules.filter: keep 1..7/8 prompts + 20% of 0/8; abort and report if fewer than 150 prompts survive
decision_rules.budget_gate: re-run plan/cost_model.py with measured rollout/learner/eval speeds; stop and report if the approved tier's new P50 exceeds 85% of its hard cap

a.packing: 3 VMs in parallel, VM i = sync-s_i (chips 0/1) + async-k2-s_i (chips 2/3); freed chips evaluate

b.packing: +3 VMs, two fixed-lag runs per VM
b.why_fixed_lag: with rollout as the bottleneck, bounded staleness sits at ~1 for any k >= 1, so a bounded k sweep would measure nothing; fixed lag forces exactly k

c.packing: +2 VMs, one 2:1 run at a time on chips 0-2, chip 3 evaluates

ablation_no_is.question: are sampler behavior log-probs and the IS correction needed? Trainer recomputes the old policy on the sampler's tokens; PPO clip only; sampler log-probs logged for diagnostics only
ablation_no_is.updates_per_batch: 1 (matches the IS arms; ratio == 1 so the clip never binds and the loss is plain on-policy PG on stale samples). --updates-per-batch 2 is a separate, unpriced variant that makes the clip active

abl_k2.packing: +2 VMs: (noIS-k2-s0, noIS-k2-s1) and (noIS-k2-s2 on chips 0/1, chips 2/3 evaluate)

abl_k4_in_b.when: tier b or c (b already has fixed-k4-s{0,1})

ablation_no_is.seeds: matched: noIS-*-s_i uses the IS arm's seed s_i (same prompt order and sampling seeds at step 0)
metrics: pass@1 v2 at steps 50/100/150 (hierarchical bootstrap, paired problems; TOST +-3 pp)
kl_behav_cur (k3, sampler vs trainer on sampled tokens), behav_ratio_mean/max, behav_would_truncate_frac
